_about: 喂饭桶 · 开炉 — the 饭桶's lottery (Hanli, 2026-10-20: 「现在可以, 但东西太少, 以后在扩吧. 装备武器饰品都可以出」; the 割绳子 in front of it is gone, 「喂饭桶那个没啥玩的」). Once he holds the 饭桶 (`needs`, the 小铜炉 古四 grants at wm-danlu) he puts up to three things and 炉炭 (`fuel`: one a 层 of his realm, bought at the pill shelves) into its mouth, presses the lid on a gold puff (压盖: the one skill step, `press`), and it spits something out (games/kailu.js on the shell). The rules roll it (rules/fantong.mjs, seeded by the day, the save's feed count, what went in and the 炉炭 — never the press, so timing can't re-roll); the page only shows. The book's 饭桶 gives anything at all (Hanli 10-20: 「剧情里, 饭桶就是什么都出的, 但要关联喂入物品等级和人物等级」): there is no cap — the odds of high things rise smoothly with what goes in (`tiers`), his realm, the 炉炭 (`odds.power`). Every output is an items.json row with a name and a `hint` — the one line of small print on it or its wrapper, never its effect (Hanli, 2026-10-06). The first time a thing lands it goes into the 饭桶图鉴 (录). Hanli will widen the table: add rows, never code. Bag only (Hanli 2026-10-27: 「下面的物品都不是储物袋中的, 可以用储物袋中的吗? 以后玩家得到新东西, 可以来测试」 · 「让玩家可以清空身上不用的物品」): the tray is his 储物袋, with its counts, and nothing else; what goes in leaves the bag — the bucket is where his spare things and his junk turn into something (the woodpile's 凡物 that once stood always at hand are gone; 周衡's culls come into the bag with 药园残株).

limit._about: `cooldown_min`: after a feed, the bucket is full that long (Hanli, 2026-10-15: one feed, then an hour). `per_day`: at most that many feeds a local day. Either, both, or neither; the refusal says when the next feed is possible. The cooldown is balance.json's (`cooldowns.fantong_min`).

never._about: What never goes IN, whatever the bag holds: these kinds (a key, a scroll — 《吐纳经》 is hers — an artifact of hers) and these things (爷爷的弓, 爹's). Story things, a key the chapter or an errand still needs, and what he wears are refused by the rules anyway (pouch.mjs freeSlot). What the story still reads from the bag goes here too (2026-10-15): the 筑基丹's 主药 (古五 → 古八; 鼎苔 is held back by count instead, `keep`); every realm's breakthrough pill (ladder.json breakthrough.pill.items — the breakthrough reaches for it in the bag); the five 天材地宝 a 本命法宝 is refined with (items.json effect.core). This list is inputs only: realm pills may still come OUT (Hanli 10-20: 「破镜, 筑基丹都可以出, 不用限制」). Ordinary gear (灰袍) stays feedable.

out._about: What never comes OUT (2026-11-12, the pool is the item book — `book`): a key or a scroll (the story alone gives them), her bell (the companion's `bell`), the book's first feed (wm-diyilu: 踏马符, 牛脂甘露, 含笑半步颠, 止笑丸, 九转回春丹 — the story hands each over on its own beat), 炉炭 (bought, never given); with them every thing the story flags `story` unless `book.gates` lets the bucket give it from a 回 on, and the book's two fixed pots (`recipes.story`, in and out). `items` above stay INPUT rules only: realm pills may still come out (Hanli 10-20: 「破境丹, 筑基丹都可以出, 不用限制」).

keep._about: Fed only past what the story still reads from the bag (Hanli 2026-10-21: 鼎苔 from the 秘境 stacked with no use — one steadies the 筑基 throw, ladder.json pill.bonus_of). The bucket sees, and may eat, only the rest; it eats it as a 凡物 (no tier row). A kept thing a breakthrough reaches for (ladder.json breakthrough.pill.items) is kept only while that breakthrough is still ahead: once the foundation is laid the last 鼎苔 is fed like the rest (rules/fantong.mjs readAhead).

kinds._about: What a thing IS to the pot (Hanli 2026-10-27: 「我扔的草药, 最好能出丹药. 扔物品出装备, 武器. 其他出符文等」): a kind that lists it (`items`), else the kind whose `item_kinds` holds its items.json kind, else `junk`. Every items.json kind has one (tests/fantong.test.mjs). Each kind leads to a `family` (below); a kind with none is a mixed handful. `tint`: the colour the steam over the mouth takes as the pot fills (the page's hint, never a number). `weight`: the share a thing of this kind has among the pool's rows (default 1; times how near its worth stands to what the grade asks) — the one hand knob on the item book: pills and gear a little over the herbs and hides they are made of. No item id is named in code.

families._about: What comes out follows what goes in (Hanli 2026-10-27): the family most of the pot's things lead to — one ahead of every other; a tie, or junk ahead, is a mixed handful — draws from the item book's rows of the families it `draw`s on (a row's family is its kind's, `kinds`; rules/fantong-roll.mjs rowsFor); when none of them holds a thing within reach of what the grade asks, its `then`. `lean`: the one line the board shows before 开炉, so he can steer the pot.

lean.zh: 多是草药 → 多半出丹
多是兽材矿料 → 多半出兵器、法衣、佩
lean.en: Mostly hides, bones and ore → likely a weapon, a robe or a pendant

lean.zh: 多是符纸朱砂 → 多半出符
lean.en: Mostly talisman paper and cinnabar → likely a talisman

lean.zh: 杂七杂八 → 多半出符和杂物
lean.en: A mixed handful → likely a talisman or odds and ends

tiers._about: 品阶 of every thing, in and out (Hanli 10-20: 「玩家等级高, 喂入等级高, 出高等级概率大」): 0 凡物 · 1 一阶 · 2 二阶 · 3 三阶 · 4 the top (九转筑基丹). An item not listed is 0. The pot's tier is its HIGHEST input (one good thing lifts the pot, so the third slot is never a trap — a mean would punish adding a 凡物). An output's tier sets how much the power lifts it (`odds.tier`).

odds._about: The roll: first a grade (凡 junk · 有用 useful · 珍品 rare · 逆天 best — grey, blue, purple, gold), then a thing of the pot's family (`families`) worth about what the grade asks: the pot's worth (what went in, and its 炉炭 at ten 灵石 a piece) × the grade's `x`, at least its `floor` (balance.json `kailu`, tools/numbers.mjs weighs it). `grades`: the weights at power 0 (a 凡物 fed by a 练气零层 with no 炉炭: 70/25/4/1). POWER = `power.in` × the pot's tier + `power.realm` × his realm + `power.lingshi` × ln(1 + ten × the 炉炭) — each stone lifts less than the one before (Hanli 11-04: 「多放可以提升出品品质」; 1.08 keeps three stones where 0.5 a stone had them, thirty about doubles 珍品+逆天). His realm counts `realm_per_tier` a whole realm (练气 0–2.7 by 层, 筑基 3+, …). Each grade's weight × `growth[grade]`^power — so a high thing is never impossible, only rare, and grows likelier smoothly with both what goes in and who feeds it. 压盖 (`press` 1): the grade rolled goes up one notch (逆天 stays).

fuel._about: 炉炭 fed with the pot (Hanli 2026-11-12: 「现在饭桶直接吞, 可否改成吞耗材, 让用户去买」): bought at the shelves that sell pills (items.json `lutan`, a price class of its own), taken from the 储物袋 and spent with the pot. Each piece lifts the pot (`odds.power.lingshi`, by ln of `stones` × the pieces: a piece counts as that many 灵石 did, ten) and counts toward its worth as they did. The most a pot takes (Hanli 11-04: 「按当前层数」): `per_layer` × his 层 counted on across the realms (练气一层 1 … 九层 9, 筑基一层 10 … 九层 18), at least `min` (练气零层). A 方子 asks its exact count of pieces: more, and the pot rolls as an ordinary one. A call that still sends `lingshi` is read as no fuel.

once._about: Things of these kinds come out once ever (state.found — he has had it, by any door): the 饭桶 never hands him a second sword, robe, pendant, pouch or bell of hers. Hanli 10-20: equipment drops, "each only once its 回 is reached".

pity._about: After `after` 凡 in a row, the next feed is at least 有用 (Hanli 10-20 asked for a pity; N = 5: at 70% 凡, five in a row comes about one run in six, so it bites now and then without flattening the odds).

quirks._about: Small chances, out of 100, rolled before the grade: `refuse` — it chews, 「呸」, and spits the pot back whole (nothing spent, no wait); `twin` — two things out of one pot (a second roll). 银月's hair is `events`.

book._about: THE POOL IS THE ITEM BOOK (Hanli 2026-11-12: 「游戏物品有个池子吗? 直接用来作为饭桶的池子吧… 不必鼓励丢垃圾进去, 池子里的东西可以多一些」): the rows a roll draws from are built by rule from items.json (rules/fantong-roll.mjs bookRows, folded in by withWorth) — every thing a player may hold, less what must never come out (`never.out`, the book's fixed pots `recipes.story`, a thing the story flags `story`), its family from its kind (`kinds`), its weight the kind's `weight` times how near its worth stands to what the grade asks. A new item in items.json is in the pool the day it is written. `gates`: a thing that opens only later (`hui` the 回 the save must have reached — huiOrder ≤ the 回 it stands in; `beast`: only once he has beaten that beast; `after`: only once he has finished that scene — 仙丹: 卷一's last, 01-end, never in 卷一; `breach`: a 破境丹, drawn only while its 阶 (items.json `tier`) is the realm one above his — 筑基丹 while he is 练气, nothing of it once he has laid the foundation); a `story` thing named here is one the bucket may give from that 回 on (古六's treasures). `worth_ls`: a rare thing the shops price too low or not at all, its own worth in minutes of income at its level. A thing of a `once` kind comes once ever, and nothing of a later 卷 (items.json `juan`) is drawn — but for the glimpse (`odds.glimpse`). `only`: the 饭桶-ONLY things (each marked `only: 'fantong'` on its items.json row; tests/fantong.test.mjs holds the two lists the same) — sold nowhere, found nowhere else — at the weight `w` they have among the rows, with the family (`family`) or gate they carry when their kind says otherwise; the humblest of them is what a pot with nothing in reach gives.

pages._about: 方子残页: every one that lands is counted on the save; at `need` the 方子 named by `recipe` is worked out (said once, kept in 录) — 古七's third 方子, 回气丹.

recipes._about: 古七's 方子 (认出三张方子): exactly the right thing (alone) with the right count of 炉炭 says which pill — the roll uses the recipe's `grades` (out of 100), 有用 gives `out`, 珍品 or 逆天 gives `best` (`n` of it, when the book says how many); the 纹 stay the roll's. Recorded on the save the first time one lands (or, `pages`, when its pages are all found), and shown in 录. `hui`: the 回 it opens in.

list._about: 古八's 九节聚气 (09-dabi; story DESIGN § 九节聚气方): 闵丹师's 君 — a ten-year 黄精, his month's wage for the 看炉 (the board `danfang-kanlu` gives it) — fed alone, 「滚出三颗丹来，颗颗三道纹」, every time: the book's own pot, three 三转聚气丹.

story._about: The book's two fixed outputs (Hanli 10-20: 「剧情里小满的飞剑就是饭桶出的」): exactly these inputs, together, give this thing every time, with the biggest gold reveal. The story already hands both over on its own way on (09-snow `feed` grants 火柴 and takes the gourd; 09-xie `go` grants 顺风溜) — that grant stays the book's, so here each is a GUARD: its inputs are refused until the scene `after` is done, and once it is, the pot gives the thing only if he doesn't already hold it (else 「这一口，它吃过了」). Neither output is in any pool, so no lottery hands them out early. 顺风溜's inputs (鯥皮, 翅膜) and 火柴's 盾片 are not items yet: a row whose inputs aren't all items is dormant (the gourd alone stands for 火柴's pot until the shards are an item).

list._in: the book: 赤铜葫芦 + 七八瓣赤铜盾片 (no item for the shards)
the book: 鯥's hide and gliding membrane (neither is an item yet — dormant)

events._about: 古四: 银月 drops one of her hairs in; the little beast on the lid turns its rump to her and out floats a horse drawn like chopsticks in a bun — 「还不如本王给你画」. Now and then she reaches for it first (only while she walks with him).

say.zh: 银月伸爪子在铜肚子上拍了一下。盖上那只小兽睁开一只眼睛，把屁股扭过来对着她。「咔哒」，飘出一张黄纸，朱砂画的一匹马，四条腿像四根筷子插在馒头上。银月脸上的毛竖了起来：「画成这个样子——还不如我给你画。」
say.en: Yinyue slaps the copper belly with a paw. The little beast on the lid opens one eye and turns its rump to her. *Click*: out floats a yellow slip, a horse in cinnabar, four legs like chopsticks stuck in a bun. The fur on her face stands up: "Drawn like that — I'd do better drawing you one myself."

zh.burp: 饭桶「嗝」了一声，才吐出来：{name}。
zh.twin: 一锅出了两样，又吐出来：{name}。
zh.spat_back: 饭桶嚼了两口，「呸」——原样吐了回来。
zh.had: 饭桶闻了闻，扭过头去——这一口，它吃过了。
zh._why: The short chip on a tile of the bag that cannot go in now (rules/fantong.mjs whyNot; Hanli 11-02): the bucket itself, worn, the story's, the one kept for a breakthrough.
zh._quips: 银月's line at the reveal, by grade (games/kailu.js says one in the shell's bubble): the data's until 台词预取 writes hers.

en.burp: The Rice Bucket goes *burp* before it spits out: {name}.
en.full: The Rice Bucket is still full — feed it again {when}.
en.twin: Two from one pot — out comes: {name}.
en.spat_back: The Rice Bucket chews twice, goes *ptoo*, and spits the lot back whole.
en.had: The Rice Bucket sniffs and turns away: it has eaten this mouthful before.
en.too_many: Three things to a pot at most.

junk: It eats with relish and spits with relish.
rare: Put it away before anyone sees.
twin: Two from one pot. It's stuffed.
